rationale: The agent canceled the order without first confirming the action with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing write. While the agent looked up the user and fetched order/product details, there is no explicit authentication step beyond an email lookup, and no user confirmation prior to executing cancel_pending_order. Additionally, the final message asserts a refund timeline that is not supported by the provided tool outputs. Therefore, it does not meet the pass bar.
